title: Medical question answering collapses in Hausa: a pre-registered pilot on three small open models
abstract: arXiv:2611.20823v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A system that reads nothing and always answers the most frequent letter scores \BaselineP{} on our Hausa medical multiple-choice set. \NBelowBaseline{} of the \NModels{} small open models we evaluate do not beat it. We lead with that because the usual summary of a multilingual result -- a percentage-point drop from English -- does not say whether what survives the drop is performance at all.   On a paired English--Hausa set of \NEval{} MedMCQA items, three instruction-tuned models of 3--4B parameters lose between \GapMedGemma{} and \GapQwen{} points of accuracy, every gap significant after Holm correction. Back-translating the Hausa items into English recovers between half and two-thirds of the gap for the two general-purpose models but not demonstrably for the medically adapted one, so the deficit is substantially, though not wholly, a matter of the language of presentation. translated_title: 豪萨语中的医学问答崩溃：针对三个小型开源模型的预注册试点研究
translated_abstract: 一个什么都不读、总是回答出现频率最高字母的系统，在我们的豪萨语医学多项选择题集上可以获得 \BaselineP{} 的分数。我们所评估的 \NModels{} 个小型开源模型中有 \NBelowBaseline{} 个未能超越它。我们以此作为开篇，是因为对多语言结果的常规总结方式——即相对于英语的百分点下降——并不能说明在下降之后所残留的是否还算得上真正的性能表现。在一个由 \NEval{} 个 MedMCQA 条目构成的英语-豪萨语配对数据集上，三个参数量为 3–4B 的指令微调模型的准确率损失介于 \GapMedGemma{} 和 \GapQwen{} 个百分点之间，且每一个差距在经过 Holm 校正后都依然显著。将豪萨语条目回译为英语，可以为两个通用模型挽回一半到三分之二的差距，但对于那个经过医学领域适配的模型则没有明显效果，因此这一性能缺陷在很大程度上（尽管并非完全）是题目呈现语言的问题。此外，答案的稳定性也大幅下降：三个选项……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该预注册试点研究发现，三个3-4B参数的小型开源模型在豪萨语医学多项选择题上的准确率显著低于英语，且回译实验表明性能崩溃主要源于题目呈现语言而非医学知识本身的缺失。
en_tdlr: In a pre-registered pilot, three small (3–4B) open models suffer significant accuracy drops on Hausa medical multiple-choice questions, and back-translation recovers half to two-thirds of the gap for general-purpose models, showing the collapse is largely a matter of presentation language rather than lost medical knowledge.
